claim: With EBS you pay only for what you provision: volume storage is charged per GB provisioned per month until you release it, and IOPS or throughput above baseline cost more.
question: What do you pay for with an EBS volume?

values.display: you pay only for what you provision
charged by the amount of GB you provision per month

evidence.quote: With Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS), you pay only for what you provision. Volume storage for all EBS volume types is charged by the amount of GB you provision per month until you release the storage. Costs increase for EBS volumes that support additional input/output operations per second (IOPS) and throughput beyond baseline performance.

claim: gp3 includes 3,000 IOPS and 125 MB/s free; additional IOPS and throughput are provisioned independently and charged per IOPS-month and per MB/s-month.
question: How are extra IOPS and throughput charged on a gp3 volume?

values.display: free baseline performance of 3,000 provisioned IOPS
values.spoken: a free baseline of three thousand provisioned IOPS

values.display: IOPS per month and MB/s per month

evidence.quote: All gp3 volumes include a free baseline performance of 3,000 provisioned IOPS (input/output operations per second) and 125 provisioned MB/s throughput. Additional IOPS and throughput can be provisioned independently and are charged by the amount you provision in IOPS per month and MB/s per month until you release the IOPS or throughput.

claim: Provisioned storage, IOPS and throughput of gp3 volumes are billed in per-second increments with a 60-second minimum.

qualifiers.condition: the same billing applies to the other types on the pricing page

evidence.quote: Provisioned storage, provisioned IOPS, and provisioned throughput for gp3 volumes will be billed in per-second increments, with a 60-second minimum.

claim: io2 volumes are charged for provisioned GB and provisioned IOPS per month, and the IOPS charges are tiered: the effective IOPS price falls as you provision more IOPS on one volume.
question: How are provisioned IOPS charged on io2 volumes?

values.display: The provisioned IOPS charges are tiered
more economical to scale IOPS on a single volume

evidence.quote: The provisioned IOPS charges are tiered. Therefore, as you provision higher IOPS on a single volume, the effective provisioned IOPS charges decrease, making it more economical to scale IOPS on a single volume.
Note that IOPS tiering is applied at a volume level.

Provisioned storage for gp2 volumes will be billed in per-second increments, with a 60-second minimum. I/O is included in the price of the volumes, so you pay only for each GB of storage you provision.

claim: In US East (N. Virginia), fast snapshot restore costs $0.75 per DSU-Hour, charged for each snapshot and each Availability Zone where it is enabled, billed per minute with a one-hour minimum, until you disable it.
question: How is fast snapshot restore priced in US East (N. Virginia)?

values.display: for each snapshot and each Availability Zone

qualifiers.scope: per snapshot, per Availability Zone, per DSU-Hour

evidence.quote: Example pricing is based on the US-East (N. Virginia) region. Fast Snapshot Restore (FSR) is charged in Data Services Unit-Hours (DSU-Hours) for each snapshot and each Availability Zone in which it is enabled. DSUs are billed per minute with a one-hour minimum. You will continue to incur charges until you disable FSR on a snapshot. The price of 1 DSU-Hour is $0.75.

claim: Snapshot storage is charged for the space the data uses in Amazon S3: the first snapshot is a full copy and each later snapshot saves only the changed part; copying snapshots across Regions is charged for the data transferred.
question: What drives the cost of EBS snapshots and of copying them to another Region?

values.display: only the changed part of your Amazon EBS volume is saved
charged for the data transferred across regions

evidence.quote: For the first snapshot of a volume, Amazon EBS saves a full copy of your data to Amazon S3. For each incremental snapshot, only the changed part of your Amazon EBS volume is saved. Copying EBS snapshots is charged for the data transferred across regions.
